categories.ambiguous: pre-match ambiguous endpoint or endpoint whose partner/matched state varies across co-optimal solutions
categories.gained: candidate endpoint that is competitively unmatched in every co-optimal solution, regardless of whether it had an admissible edge consumed by another endpoint
categories.lost: REF endpoint that is competitively unmatched in every co-optimal solution, regardless of whether it had an admissible edge consumed by another endpoint
categories.retained: endpoint in a stable pair present in every co-optimal solution; exactly two retained endpoint rows share one deterministic pair_id

category_denominators.all_endpoint_N: REF endpoint rows plus candidate endpoint rows in comparison and epoch

classification_and_matching.cooptimal_endpoint_rule: For each endpoint compare its assignment across every co-optimal solution. A pair present identically in every solution is stable. An endpoint whose partner or matched/unmatched state differs across solutions is ambiguous. An endpoint unmatched in every solution is competitively unmatched.
classification_and_matching.endpoint_universe: Every REF and comparison-arm event row with global frame in the common crop enters exactly once before any anchor or provenance gate.
classification_and_matching.matching: Within comparison and epoch, build all edges between non-pre-ambiguous endpoints with absolute global-frame lag <=15 and physical anchor distance <=80 um. Enumerate the co-optimal solution set: maximum cardinality first, minimum total absolute lag second. Lexicographic edge order is recorded only as an audit representative and never resolves scientific ambiguity.
classification_and_matching.no_double_credit: Each endpoint row appears once and in at most one pair_id; stable retained pair_ids are unique.
classification_and_matching.pair_id: SHA256(comparison || NUL || epoch || NUL || REF source_arm || NUL || decimal REF row_id || NUL || candidate source_arm || NUL || decimal candidate row_id)
classification_and_matching.partition: The four categories are mutually exclusive and collectively exhaustive over endpoint_universe. Assert ledger row count equals REF endpoint count plus candidate endpoint count, each (source_arm,source_row_id) occurs once, each row has exactly one category, lost rows are REF only, gained rows are candidate only, and each retained pair_id has exactly one endpoint from each arm.
classification_and_matching.pre_match_ambiguous: An endpoint with unsupported anchor (-1) or an arm/row provenance conflict is category=ambiguous with a single reason code and is excluded from matching. Merely having a time-near cross-arm endpoint farther than 80 um is not ambiguity; that edge is simply inadmissible.
classification_and_matching.tolerance_reason: Align exactly with the evaluator's frozen 0.5 ms correspondence tolerance rather than the earlier +/-1-sample sketch.

denominators_and_intervals.ambiguous_fraction: ambiguous endpoint population_N divided by all endpoint rows for the same comparison and epoch
denominators_and_intervals.conditional_support_fraction: supported_n / technically_evaluable_n, descriptive only; null when denominator is zero
denominators_and_intervals.dependence_scope: Wilson intervals treat sampled endpoint rows as Bernoulli rows and do not cover within-unit, within-pair, time, recording, or sorter dependence.
denominators_and_intervals.population_N: endpoint category count from the exhaustive event ledger; retained also reports retained_pair_N=retained_endpoint_N/2
denominators_and_intervals.population_rate_per_core_minute: population_N / epoch_exposure_minutes for lost, gained, and ambiguous endpoint categories
denominators_and_intervals.sampled_n: selected endpoint rows: <=128 for each nonretained stratum and exactly twice selected_pair_n for retained
denominators_and_intervals.supported_rate_interval: population_rate multiplied by Wilson lower and upper bounds; sampling uncertainty only
denominators_and_intervals.unsupported_gained_rate_interval: [gained population_rate * (1 - gained support Wilson upper), gained population_rate * (1 - gained support Wilson lower)]
denominators_and_intervals.waveform_support_fraction: supported_n / sampled_n; unevaluable rows count as not supported
denominators_and_intervals.wilson: For k successes in n sampled rows and z=1.959963984540054, center=(k+z^2/2)/(n+z^2), half=z*sqrt(k*(n-k)/n+z^2/4)/(n+z^2), lower=max(0,center-half), upper=min(1,center+half).
denominators_and_intervals.zero_sample: If population_N=0 then sampled_n=0, fractions and Wilson bounds are null, status=NO_POPULATION; never PASS or FAIL.

enablement_rule: This H5-only freeze remains non-executable. A separately reviewed derivative must bind all prospective arm/anchor inputs, retain every accepted scientific field, verify this actual H5 runtime and current voltage receipt, and set both gates true.

epochs.denominator_scope: core crop only; filter padding never adds exposure
epochs.intervals: half-open; each eligible event belongs to exactly one epoch; final stop excluded

explicit_exclusions: sorting, sorter training, detection, clustering, template refit, or threshold search

first_result_preservation.atomic_publication: Build in staging, verify hashes, rename once to absent final destination, write COMPLETE last.
first_result_preservation.output_namespace: A future enabled contract must name a fresh absent destination and fresh staging directory.
first_result_preservation.retry: A retry requires a new namespace and links the failed packet; the first result and first frozen sample ledger remain immutable.

anchor_field.rule: Each event receives the exact precomputed physical-channel index from its containing frozen global-frame field cell. Unsupported is -1. No depth-nearness, motion-estimate fallback, or post-outcome anchor substitution is allowed.

required_per_arm: spike_times.npy sha256, shape, dtype, and global-acquisition-sample frame
spike_clusters.npy sha256, shape, dtype, and row equality with spike_times
spike_positions.npy sha256 and spatial_identity_sha256 from the repaired evaluator
ops.npy sha256, nblocks=0, dshift=None, identity chanMap, and geometry hash
curated identity digest and event-lineage digest
event_sources.truth_scope: The historical H5 REF/B receipt values are producer claims only. They are not execution bindings until recomputed from local bytes by the enabled preflight.

outputs_and_receipts.hash_policy: Hash every input binding, source file, output file, and frozen contract. MANIFEST covers all successful outputs except COMPLETE; COMPLETE binds MANIFEST and is written last.
outputs_and_receipts.publication: Publish only ledgers, metrics, aggregate scorecards, hashes, and receipts. Do not publish raw voltage or numeric waveform arrays.
required: COMPLETE.json written last on success only

purpose: technical physical-signal support screen for retained, gained, lost, and ambiguous event endpoints; never identity, purity, or sorter efficacy evidence

quality_and_decision.benefit: In at least two epochs: existing waveform-supported-lost lower bound minus repaired waveform-supported-lost upper bound >=0.5 endpoints/core minute OR existing ambiguous fraction minus repaired ambiguous fraction >=0.05; and repaired unsupported-gained upper bound minus existing unsupported-gained upper bound <=0.5.
quality_and_decision.empty_or_unavailable: Any required arm, comparison, or epoch unavailable yields INCONCLUSIVE; never infer zero.
quality_and_decision.harm: For every epoch, repaired waveform-supported lost-rate upper bound minus existing waveform-supported lost-rate lower bound must be <=0.5 endpoints/core minute.
quality_and_decision.low_N: Apply the same Wilson formula for 1<=n<128 and disclose n; no normal approximation, imputation, pooling, or threshold relaxation.
quality_and_decision.overall: Technical screen only. No advancement decision is authorized by this contract.
quality_and_decision.repeat_gate: REF384_vs_REF384_repeat must not be FAIL in any nonempty epoch/category stratum; otherwise efficacy interpretation is inconclusive.
quality_and_decision.stratum_CAUTION: sampled_n>0 AND not PASS AND (technically_evaluable_fraction>=0.60 OR waveform-support Wilson lower>=0.40)
quality_and_decision.stratum_FAIL: sampled_n>0 and neither PASS nor CAUTION
quality_and_decision.stratum_PASS: sampled_n>0 AND technically_evaluable_fraction>=0.80 AND waveform-support Wilson lower>=0.60

resources_and_stop_conditions.on_stop: Close inputs, preserve frozen ledgers/logs/counters and FAILURE.json, do not write COMPLETE, do not retry or substitute records automatically.

read_accounting.endpoint_read_count: number of SAMPLE_LEDGER endpoint rows; retained pairs contribute two
read_accounting.kernel_or_device_bytes: record process and block-device counters before/after as observed diagnostics; caching/read amplification may differ and is not substituted for exact API accounting
read_accounting.one_endpoint_read: one os.pread request for exactly 1145*384*2 = 879360 contiguous bytes from the interleaved physical binary
read_accounting.physical_api_requested_bytes: sum of successful os.pread requested byte counts; must equal logical_payload_bytes; short reads fail
read_accounting.physical_api_returned_bytes: sum of bytes actually returned by os.pread; must equal physical_api_requested_bytes

runtime_closure_preflight.failure: Any runtime identity/configuration/probe disagreement stops before voltage access.

resources_and_stop_conditions.segment_read_receipt_rule: READ_RECEIPT records one row per SAMPLE_LEDGER endpoint with record_id, global frame, exact offset, requested bytes, returned bytes, and pre/post stat tuple; totals must equal 4,608-or-fewer bounded endpoint calls and no identity-preflight voltage read is included because it is forbidden.
stop_before_read: missing required arm or anchor binding
output or staging namespace already exists
contract not independently reviewed and enabled

voltage_identity_preflight.binary_operation: os.lstat only; no symlink following; exact current-hash final stat tuple
compact_files_hashed: current MANIFEST.sha256, COMPLETE.json, CURRENT_VOLTAGE_FULL_HASH_RECEIPT.json, and every current manifest member

sampling.first_selection_preserved: Write and hash EVENT_LEDGER and SAMPLE_LEDGER before voltage access; never replace failed or unevaluable selected rows.
sampling.maximum_derivation: 3 comparisons * 3 epochs * (3 nonretained categories * 128 endpoint reads + 64 retained pairs * 2 endpoint reads) = 4608
sampling.nonretained_rank_key: SHA256(seed_utf8 || NUL || comparison || NUL || epoch || NUL || category || NUL || source_arm || NUL || decimal_global_frame || NUL || decimal_source_row_id)
sampling.retained_atomicity: Select pair_id atomically. Both endpoint rows enter SAMPLE_LEDGER and both are read, or neither is selected. No partner read may occur outside SAMPLE_LEDGER.
sampling.retained_pair_rank_key: SHA256(seed_utf8 || NUL || comparison || NUL || epoch || NUL || retained || NUL || pair_id || NUL || decimal_REF_global_frame || NUL || decimal_candidate_global_frame || NUL || decimal_REF_row_id || NUL || decimal_candidate_row_id)

technical_support.identity_limit: Technical support and correlation do not establish biological identity or purity.
technical_support.loss_semantics: Lost means unmatched REF event under the frozen event matcher. It does not mean a biological spike disappeared.
technical_support.missing_semantics: Every selected record contributes once to sampled_n. Unevaluable is not silently excluded from support denominators and cannot be supported.

retained_pair_correlation.channels: Sorted intersection of the two endpoints' frozen physical analysis-channel indices; require at least 2 common channels.
retained_pair_correlation.formula: Pearson correlation: subtract each flattened vector mean, dot the centered vectors, divide by product of L2 norms.
retained_pair_correlation.low_N: Per comparison/epoch report valid_pair_n and median correlation. n=0 -> null/NO_VALID_PAIRS; n=1 -> the single value with NO_INTERVAL; n>=2 -> median only, no confidence interval or pooling.
retained_pair_correlation.priority_rule: Evaluate reasons once in the listed order and emit the first applicable code. Never drop nonfinite samples, relax channel/frame minima, or continue to a lower-priority reason. ALIGNMENT_FAILURE covers invalid rank/shape, noninteger or duplicate channel identities, channel/value row disagreement, noninteger center frame, and out-of-range physical channel indices. Constant vectors and any other exactly zero centered L2 norm emit ZERO_VARIANCE unless an earlier reason also applies.
retained_pair_correlation.selection: Only atomically sampled retained pair_ids; both endpoint reads must be present in SAMPLE_LEDGER. No extra read or one-sided correlation is permitted.
retained_pair_correlation.status: MEASURED when valid; otherwise UNMEASURED with exactly one frozen reason and null value. Correlation is descriptive and never a technical-support or advancement gate.
retained_pair_correlation.time_alignment: Use absolute global acquisition frames. Endpoint signal windows are [global_frame-20,global_frame+21). Intersect these half-open windows and map each common absolute frame back to its endpoint core. Require at least 26 common frames; the 15-frame match tolerance guarantees 26 when both full signal windows exist.
retained_pair_correlation.valid: both endpoints technically_evaluable, both selected, >=2 common channels, >=26 common frames, all values finite, and both centered vectors have nonzero L2 norm
retained_pair_correlation.vectors: For each endpoint use its own baseline-referenced processed values, ordered channel-major then ascending absolute frame. Flatten the same common channels/frames for both endpoints.

technical_support.supported: technically_evaluable AND leading-channel PTP/noise >=6.0 AND adjacent-channel PTP/noise >=4.0 AND center_offset <=15
technical_support.technically_evaluable: valid identities and anchor, complete padding, no saturation/clipping, finite processed core, at least two analysis channels, and finite nonzero noise estimates

voltage_identity.channel_order: physical acquisition rows 0..383, identity order; never sorter/template order

preflight.identity_claim: The current full read exactly reproduces the historic expected SHA-256 and size; future compact preflight binds that receipt and its exact final lstat tuple.
preflight.rule: Verify both historic and current full-hash packets and every current manifest member; use os.lstat with no symlink following; require the exact regular-file stat tuple captured after the current hash; hash only compact receipts and the recording manifest.

voltage_identity.representation: original accepted full-probe physical acquisition only

waveform_extraction.adjacent_channel: Non-leading analysis channel with smallest Euclidean geometry distance to the leading channel; exact ties choose the lowest physical channel index.
waveform_extraction.analysis_channels: Sorted union of anchor channel and all physical channel indices whose Euclidean geometry distance from the anchor is <=80.0 um. Read all 384 channels but compute support only on this frozen union.
waveform_extraction.baseline_reference: For each analysis channel subtract the median over the 60 baseline samples after preprocessing.
waveform_extraction.center_offset: Absolute sample difference between global_frame/core index 60 and the leading-channel largest-absolute baseline-referenced signal extremum; extremum ties choose earliest sample.
waveform_extraction.leading_channel: Analysis channel with greatest signal-window peak-to-peak amplitude; exact ties choose the lowest physical channel index.
waveform_extraction.noise: 1.4826 * median(abs(baseline_samples - median(baseline_samples))) per channel, floored at 1.0 ADC-equivalent filter unit.
waveform_extraction.padding_rule: Read exact full-recording samples [global_frame-572, global_frame+573). If either bound is outside [0,314204894), mark missing_padding; do not clip, reflect, zero-fill, resample, or choose a replacement event.

accepted_dependency_resolution.rule: Resolve dependency_closure and all of its members within this immutable accepted parent packet, or within a byte-identical mirror whose MANIFEST and COMPLETE hashes match exactly.

executable_runtime_closure.capture_rule: In a clean Linux process, load the frozen impulse, execute the accepted 384x1145 CPU float32 median/FFT/ifft/fftshift probe, then hash sys.executable and every unique resolved ELF file mapped in /proc/self/maps.
executable_runtime_closure.deployment_scope: actual H5 executable runtime only; exact relocatable-path byte identity; no general cross-host portability
executable_runtime_closure.portable_rule: Within the actual H5 deployment, paths are diagnostic only and may relocate only when the exact role/basename/size/SHA-256 multiset, platform/Python/backend fields, numerical probe, member count/bytes, and aggregate all match. A nonmatching reviewer host is the required negative control, not a portability failure.

preprocessing.implementation: packet source/waveform_preprocessing.py reproducing the exercised CPU float32 semantics of kilosort.io.BinaryFiltered.filter and kilosort.preprocessing.fft_highpass
preprocessing.reference_warning: This is not common-average reference. The legacy Kilosort do_CAR name invokes torch.median across channels.
preprocessing.state: stateless independent padded record; filter state reset for every record

waveform_extraction.saturation: If any raw padded int16 value on any of 384 channels equals -32768 or 32767, mark saturation_clipping and unevaluable.
